1	import { pgTable, uuid, text, timestamp, date, index, jsonb } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
2	import type { AgentEnvConfig } from "@paperclipai/shared";
3	import { companies } from "./companies.js";
4	import { goals } from "./goals.js";
5	import { agents } from "./agents.js";
6	
7	export const projects = pgTable(
8	  "projects",
9	  {
10	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
11	    companyId: uuid("company_id").notNull().references(() => companies.id),
12	    goalId: uuid("goal_id").references(() => goals.id),
13	    name: text("name").notNull(),
14	    description: text("description"),
15	    status: text("status").notNull().default("backlog"),
16	    leadAgentId: uuid("lead_agent_id").references(() => agents.id),
17	    targetDate: date("target_date"),
18	    color: text("color"),
19	    env: jsonb("env").$type<AgentEnvConfig>(),
20	    pauseReason: text("pause_reason"),
21	    pausedAt: timestamp("paused_at", { withTimezone: true }),
22	    executionWorkspacePolicy: jsonb("execution_workspace_policy").$type<Record<string, unknown>>(),
23	    archivedAt: timestamp("archived_at", { withTimezone: true }),
24	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
25	    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
26	  },
27	  (table) => ({
28	    companyIdx: index("projects_company_idx").on(table.companyId),
29	  }),
30	);
31
